title: reference/options.json
description: Ships' option effects, read from the book. audit_effects.py checks these conditions itself (the jsonschema library is not installed), so this file is a contract for people and agents - and it is kept as strict as the code's check.

ship.description: The ship's name exactly as in bfg_data.json's nm field.

text.description: The option's text. Matching is done on the first 120 characters, so the start is enough but it must match the book exactly.

page.description: The page of the Fleets WiP book the decision was read from. Required: an acknowledgement without a page is not valid.

effect.description: A structured effect, or null if the option does NOT change the profile. Implemented in build_data.py's OPT_EFFECTS table - EXCEPT when modelled_by is given: then effect only describes the effect that is already in the data through that field, and it is not added again.

mod.description: A stat ADDITION (not a setting): tu=1 means +1 turret.

set.description: Tekstistatsin ASETUS (mod lisaa lukuun, set korvaa tekstin): sp = nopeus, tn = kaanto, ar = panssari. Endeavour p.72: ar '6+ front / 5+', tn '45°'.

swp.description: A change to a weapon row's field. f = a regex of the row's name, onlyrg = only rows whose range contains this (Mercury: only the 45 cm batteries), rg = range, rgadd = ADDS a new ordnance type to the range cell without replacing (torpedo-bommas: 'Torpedo-Bommas: 20 cm'), st = firepower (absolute or +N/-N).

sw.description: A REPLACEMENT of weapon rows with an alternative (a tick box on the card): f = the indexes of the rows to replace in the aw table, t = the replacing rows in the same order. The same structure swaps.py produces; used when swaps.py does not parse the sentence (Omnissiah p.126).

add.description: A new weapon row [name, range, firepower, arc] OR a list of them (Murder: the port and starboard lance), on the card only when the option is chosen (take = ticked, opt = an empty box, off = no row). The same 4-array as a list upgrade's en.add.

del.description: A regex: the chosen option REMOVES the weapon rows whose name matches (Cobra p.84: the detection refit 'removes the squadron's weapons batteries').

modelled_by.description: Optional. The effect IS already in the data in this field, and the words the audit finds (e.g. a torpedo's 'speed: 30 cm', 'turret strength') are not a separate profile change. Used instead of effect: null, so the acknowledgement does not claim 'no effect' for an option that has an effect.

why.description: In one or two sentences: what the page says and what follows from it.

verified.description: Only true is valid. A row that has not been verified does not belong here but in the queue.
